methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected from each vendor's official pricing page on the access date. monthlyUsd records the month-to-month rate; where only annual billing is published, the annualized monthly rate is used and the month-to-month rate noted. annualDiscountPct is set only when both monthly and annual rates are explicitly stated or when a precise discount figure is published. Quote-only / contact-sales tiers carry monthlyUsd null. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on every plan (non-telephony vertical). hipaa and baa are true/false only when explicitly stated on the pricing page; else null. Corroboration sources are independent third-party review/comparison pages accessed on the same date.
